name: navbar-vertical-spacing
goal: Give the explorer navbar and wrapped branch/commit row vertical breathing room while retaining compact selectors and the divider

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Navigation touches its outer edges, and wrapped revision controls have only 2px above/below. Require 8px breathing room while retaining the divider and 32px fields.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing standardized shell tests check compactness and divider geometry but no minimum vertical inset. Extend that same desktop/tablet/mobile scenario with measured spacing assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 137de60c: isolated test fails with space above navigation (0px, expected >=8) across desktop, tablet and mobile. Immutable red checkpoint recorded before CSS repair.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 8460b62c adds 8px block padding to the shared header and wrapped revision row, retaining compact fields and the divider.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 8460b62c: all 9 unchanged navigation tests pass in an isolated clean snapshot; same command, environment, tests and fixtures as red.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Scoped checks pass: 44 browser cases, 591 Reports unit tests, Reports typecheck/lint/build/audit and root formatting. Fresh live screenshot /tmp/harness-navbar-spacing-final.jpg inspected; no console errors. Full root check was attempted, stopped at generated loop formatting (now fixed); full repository verification remains incomplete, with prior unrelated desktop/Hub/Remote failures documented in their loops. No Electron/native testing or main merge.
